trajectory_summary: Call opens with an unusually receptive customer who volunteers his own solar rationale, and the rep runs the qualification checklist efficiently and gets every required data point. The back half stalls on a multi-minute texting/bill-delivery friction loop that the rep handles patiently rather than efficiently, and the rep never returns to the customer's stated interest reason to reinforce it at booking. Overall the call is flat-to-positive: qualification completed and appointment set, but energy is procedural rather than built.
